playground.title: Playground
playground.cardDescription: Cloud IDE for JavaScript, TypeScript, Python and Vite projects.
playground.budgetNote: Shared by all users. Daily starts reset at 00:00 UTC. Vercel meters its own limits separately.
playground.addFileHint: Create a file or folder to get started.
playground.repoHint: Vite app with an npm or pnpm lockfile. Preview links are public until they expire. Do not use secrets.
playground.noFileHint: Select a file or create a new one in the Explorer.
playground.noAppHint: Import a Vite project from the Explorer to preview it here.
playground.emptyConsole: Run the active file to see its output here.
playground.emptyRepoConsole: Import and run a Vite project to start a preview.
playground.deletePrompt: Remove {name} from this workspace? This cannot be undone.
playground.previewExpired: Preview expired. Start a new run to open it again.
playground.invalidFilename: Enter a valid name. If it is nested, check the length of its full path.
playground.duplicateFilename: This folder already contains a file or folder with that name.
playground.signInToRun: Sign in with your gareev.de account to run code.
playground.stopFailed: Could not confirm Stop. The preview will expire automatically.
playground.badInput: Supply a valid workspace with a JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or HTML entry (up to 20 files and 64 KiB), or a public GitHub repository URL.
playground.deploymentDisabled: Cloud runs are not enabled on this deployment.
playground.slotBusy: The shared sandbox slot is busy. Try again when the current run ends.
playground.dailyLimit: The shared daily start limit has been reached.
playground.timeLimit: There is not enough shared runtime left for this run.
playground.sandboxFailed: Sandbox did not finish. Check Vercel setup or reduce the project size and retry.
playground.quotaUnavailable: Playground quota unavailable. No run was started.
playground.packageMissing: No package.json in the selected directory.
playground.lockfileMissing: Commit a package-lock.json or pnpm-lock.yaml at the repository root.
playground.viteNotReady: Vite did not become ready on port 4173. Check the dev script.
playground.stageFailed: {stage} failed. No cloud result was returned.
playground.deleteFolderPrompt: Delete {name} and everything inside it? This cannot be undone.
playground.invalidDestination: Choose an existing folder outside the item you are moving.
playground.notRunnable: Open a JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python file to run, or HTML to preview
playground.htmlPublicNotice: Preview files are public to anyone with the link until it expires. Don’t include secrets.
playground.htmlNotReady: HTML preview did not become ready.
playground.installingAndRunning: Preparing npm dependencies and running the file…
playground.workspaceNpmManifestMissing: Add package.json and package-lock.json to the workspace root.
playground.workspaceNpmInvalidManifest: Use valid package.json and npm v2 or v3 package-lock.json files with public npm registry dependencies only.
playground.workspaceNpmReservedPath: Remove the node_modules file or folder from the workspace root. It is created by npm.
playground.workspaceNpmHint: To use public npm packages, add package.json and package-lock.json at the project root.
